blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online reasoning video segmentation (Online RVS) requires a model to segment query-referred objects as a video streams in, using only the frames observed so far. Existing formulations largely assume a fixed target set throughout the video, overlooking a fundamental property of streaming reasoning: as new events occur, the objects that satisfy a query may change over time. To address this, we propose a new task, Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation (GRVS), where the target set depends on query-relevant events accumulated over the observed video history. As new evidence accumulates, the target set can evolve from empty to one or multiple objects, requiring a model to continuously maintain target validity while localizing the valid objects currently in view. To evaluate GRVS, we build Isekai, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 videos and 197 queries across 11 temporal query families, with 12,569 scoring points whose target sets are causally annotated over time. We further propose Sekai, an online framework with two complementary components: an Event Memory Reasoner (EMR) that maintains query-relevant events and evolving target states in structured memory, and a Memory-Grounded Decoder (MGD) that identifies valid targets from this memory and localizes them in the current frame. Experiments show that Sekai significantly outperforms existing online RVS methods, achieving 50.33 J&F and improving over the strongest baseline by 3.2 points. Code, example annotations, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/zenastangbi/Sekai.
blocks.zh: 在线推理视频分区(Online RVS)需要一种模式,将查询参考对象作为视频流在其中,只使用迄今为止观察到的帧. 现有配方基本上假设在整个视频中设定了固定的目标,俯瞰流派推理的基本属性:随着新事件的发生,满足查询的物体可能会随时间而变化. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议了一项新的任务,即通用理性视频分区(GRVS),其中设定的目标取决于在所观测到的视频历史中积累的与查询相关的事件. 随着新证据的积累,目标集可以从空到一个或多个对象,需要一个模型来持续保持目标有效性,同时将当前所看到的有效对象定位. 为了评估GRVS,我们建立了Isekai,这是11个时间查询家庭的60个视频和197个查询的诊断基准,有12 569个评分点,其目标集随时间推移而作因果说明。 我们进一步提出Sekai,一个包含两个互补部分的在线框架:一个事件记忆理性器(EMR),在结构化的内存中维持与查询相关的事件和不断发展的目标状态,以及一个内存Grounded Decoder(MGD),从这个内存中识别出有效的目标,并在当前框架中将其本地化. 实验显示,Sekai大大超过了现有的在线RVS方法,实现了50.33 J&F,比最强基线提高了3.2分. 代码、实例说明和评价脚本见https://github.com/zenastangbi/Sekai。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Online Reasoning Video Segmentation (Online RVS) brings language-guided segmentation to streaming video, where the system can only access frames observed so far and must produce segmentation results on the fly. Unlike offline settings with the complete video available, the model in online RVS cannot access future context or defer its decision to the end of the sequence. Online segmentation is thus essential for real-world applications that must continuously adapt to an unfolding visual stream.
blocks.zh: 在线理性视频分区(Online RVS)为流媒体视频带来了语言引导分区,系统只能访问迄今为止观察到的帧,必须在苍蝇上产生分区结果. 与拥有完整视频的离线设置不同,在线RVS中的模型无法访问未来上下文,也无法将其决定推迟到序列结束. 因此,在线分割对于必须不断适应正在发展的视觉流的现实世界应用至关重要。

blocks.en: However, the online setting exposes a fundamental yet largely overlooked challenge: the segmentation target can evolve as the video unfolds. Consider the example in Figure 1 , where the query asks, “Which dogs have stood up?”. Before either dog stands up, there is no valid target; after the first dog stands up, only that dog should be segmented; once the second dog also stands up, both dogs become valid targets. More generally, the target set can grow, shrink, or switch between instances as new evidence arrives. Two common online paradigms struggle with such evolving targets. Reference-tracking methods ground the referred object once and then follow it, regardless of whether other instances later satisfy the query, and thus miss the second dog. Window-based methods ground the query only within the current observation window; once the first dog’s standing-up event leaves the window, they output an empty mask, even though the dog remains a valid target.
blocks.zh: 然而,在线环境暴露了一个基本但基本上被忽视的挑战:分化目标可以随着视频的展开而演变. 以图1为例,其中询问“哪只狗站起来了?” 在任何一只狗站起来之前,都没有有效的目标;在第一只狗站起来之后,只有那只狗应该被分割;一旦第二只狗也站起来,两只狗都成为有效的目标. 更一般地说,随着新证据的到来,目标设定可以增长,缩小,或者在实例之间切换. 两种共同的在线模式与这种不断演变的目标作斗争。 引用跟踪方法一次地对被引用对象进行定位,然后跟踪它,无论其他事件是否后来满足了查询,从而错过了第二条狗. 基于窗口的方法只在当前观测窗口内对查询进行打压;一旦第一个狗的站立事件离开窗口,它们会输出一个空面具,尽管狗仍然是有效的目标.

blocks.en: Yet existing online methods are largely built around a fixed-target formulation and cannot adapt to evolving target sets. Both paradigms above share a common cause: they do not explicitly record which objects have already satisfied the query and what events support that decision. Window-based methods discard evidence once it leaves the current window. Reference-tracking methods use temporal memory mainly to propagate the identified target across frames, through visual features or cached tokens. Such memory captures what the target looks like, but not how the target set changes as new events occur. The same limitation appears at the evaluation level: existing benchmarks typically assign a fixed target set to the entire video, and thus cannot directly test whether a model correctly follows changes in the valid target set over time.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的在线方法主要围绕固定目标的制定,无法适应不断变化的成套目标。 上述两种模式都有一个共同的原因:它们没有明确记录哪些对象已经满足了查询要求,哪些事件支持了这一决定。 基于窗口的方法一旦离开当前窗口就丢弃了证据. 参考跟踪方法主要使用时间内存,通过视觉特征或缓存的代号,跨帧传播已识别的目标. 这种内存能捕捉到目标是什么样子,但不能捕捉到目标如何设定随着新事件的发生而变化. 同样的限制出现在评价层面:现有基准一般会给整个视频指定固定目标,因此无法直接测试一个模型是否正确跟踪了随着时间的推移设定的有效目标的变化.

blocks.en: Therefore, we formalize a new task, Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation (GRVS). In GRVS, the model processes the video as a stream. At each moment, the valid target set is determined by the query-relevant events observed so far, rather than by a one-time reference or the current window alone. As the stream evolves, this set may change in both size and membership. Importantly, target validity is also distinct from instantaneous visibility: an object may remain a valid target even when temporarily occluded or outside the frame, and should be segmented again once it becomes visible. GRVS thus generalizes reasoning video segmentation in three aspects: it operates causally on a stream, allows the target set to vary in size and over time, and separates target validity from visibility. These properties give rise to two fundamental requirements: maintaining the evolving target state over time and localizing the currently visible valid targets at each moment.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们正式确定一项新的任务,即一般理性视频分区。 在GRVS中,模型将视频作为流处理. 在每个时刻,有效的目标设定都由迄今为止观察到的与查询相关的事件决定,而不是由一次性参考或当前窗口单独决定. 随着溪流的演化,这一集在规模和会籍上都可能会发生变化. 重要的是,目标有效性也不同于瞬间可见度:一个物体即使暂时占据或框架外,也可能仍然是有效的目标,一旦可见,就应当再次被分割. GRVS因此在三个方面概括了推理视频分解:它在一个流上因果地运行,允许目标集在大小和时间上变化,并将目标有效性与能见度区分开来. 这些属性产生了两个基本要求:随着时间的推移保持不断变化的目标状态,并在每一时刻将目前可见的有效目标本地化.

blocks.en: To evaluate GRVS, we construct Isekai , a diagnostic benchmark of 60 real videos, 197 queries, and 12,569 scored query-frame instances. Unlike existing benchmarks, Isekai annotates targets causally: the valid target set at each frame depends only on what has been observed up to that frame, and thus changes over time. The queries span 11 temporal query families, ranging from current states, past occurrences, and most recent events to absent events, event counts, and temporal order. Instances are further stratified by how long ago the supporting evidence occurred, which allows us to measure how well a model retains past evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了评价GRVS,我们构建了Isekai, 诊断基准有60个真实视频、197个查询和12 569个打分的查询框。 与现有基准不同的是,Isekai对目标作出因果说明:在每个框架设定的有效目标仅取决于所观察到的直至该框架的情况,从而随着时间推移而变化。 这些查询涉及11个时间查询家庭,从目前的状态、过去的发生和最近的事件到没有发生的事件、事件统计和时间顺序不等。 案件还按证明证据发生多久的时间来分类,这使我们能够衡量模型保留过去证据的情况。

blocks.en: To meet these two requirements, we introduce Sekai , an online framework whose name summarizes its design: knowledge of query-relevant events is accumulated in increments, one arriving chunk at a time, in a structured text memory, and segmentation is decoded from this knowledge rather than from the current window alone. As each video chunk arrives, the Event Memory Reasoner (EMR) maintains the evolving target state by recording query-relevant events in this memory, keeping, for each object, what it has done and when. The Memory-Grounded Decoder (MGD) then reasons over the memory to decide which objects currently satisfy the query, and localizes those visible in the current frame. Experiments on Isekai show that Sekai consistently outperforms existing online methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in reasoning over dynamically evolving targets.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这两个要求,我们引入了Sekai, 一个在线框架,其名称概括了它的设计: 与查询相关的事件的知识以递增方式积累,一次一个到达块,在结构化的文本存储器中,从这个知识中解码,而不是仅仅从目前的窗口中解码. 随着每个视频块的到来,事件记忆因子(EMR)通过记录这个内存中与查询相关的事件来维持不断演变的目标状态,为每个对象保留它所做的以及何时完成. 然后内存-Grounded Decoder(MGD)在内存上解释原因,决定哪些对象目前满足了查询,并将当前框架中可见的物体本地化. Isekai的实验表明,Sekai的成绩一贯高于现有的在线方法,表明其在推理方面的效力高于动态变化的目标。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We formalize GRVS, a streaming task in which query-relevant events observed so far determine a time-varying target set of variable size, and target validity is decoupled from instantaneous visibility. • We introduce Isekai, a diagnostic benchmark for GRVS spanning 11 temporal query families. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to provide causally defined, time-varying target annotations. • We propose Sekai, an online segmentation framework for GRVS that records query-relevant events in a structured text memory, and decodes the resulting variable-sized target set into current-frame masks.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们正式确定GRVS,这是一项流线任务,迄今为止观测到的与查询相关的事件决定了一组可变大小的时间变化目标,目标有效性与瞬间可见度脱钩。 我们引入了Isekai, 一个诊断基准 GRVS 覆盖11个时间查询家庭。 据我们所知,这是第一个提供因果界定、时间变化指标说明的基准。 我们提议将Sekai作为GRVS的在线分区框架,在结构化的文本存储器中记录与查询相关的事件,并将由此产生的可变大小目标解码为当前框架的面具。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Referring video object segmentation grounds language expressions to video masks, with motion-centric expressions making temporal dynamics an explicit part of the query ( Ding et al., 2023 ) . Reasoning variants extend expressions to implicit descriptions that require world knowledge or multi-step inference, typically by decoding multimodal language model representations into masks or tracks ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Munasinghe et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . A second line decouples semantic selection from spatial-temporal propagation, either by prompting propagation from reasoned keyframes ( Kao et al., 2026 ) or by pairing candidate selection with dedicated tracking stages ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Generalized referring segmentation introduced empty- and multi-target outputs for images (GRES ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , GSVA ( Xia et al., 2024 ) ), but video formulations still assume static instance identities across the sequence. GRVS instead makes eligibility a function of prefix-confirmed events.
blocks.zh: 将视频物体分解的表达方式与视频口罩联系起来,以运动为中心的表达方式使时间动态成为查询的明显部分(Ding等人,2023年). 理性变体将表达扩展至需要世界知识或多步推论的隐含描述,一般通过将多模式语言模型表达符解码为口罩或音轨(Bai等人,2024年;Yan等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2025年;Munasinghe等人,2025年;Gong等人,2025年;Yuan等人,2026年). 第二行从时空传播中脱钩语义选择,其方法是通过合理的键框促进传播(Kao等人,2026年)或将候选人选择与专用跟踪阶段对齐(Jin等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年)。 通用的参考分解为图像引入了空和多目标输出(GRES(Liu等人,2023年),GSVA(Xia等人,2024年)),但视频配方仍然具有全序列的静态实例身份. 反之,GRVS使得资格成为前缀确认事件的一种功能.

blocks.en: Existing streaming trackers and reasoning frameworks propagate implicit states across time: target queries for selected instances ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , visual and mask memories built on SAM2 ( Cuttano et al., 2025 ; Ravi et al., 2024 ) , recurrent language embeddings or token reservoirs ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , or re-evaluated keyframe contexts ( Kao et al., 2026 ) . Long-video models similarly retain visual memory banks or compressed KV caches ( He et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Di et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2025 ). However, these approaches rely on continuous visual features or implicit latent tokens, which struggle to preserve symbolic event histories once visual evidence exits the local temporal window. Sekai instead carries an explicit, editable text memory of objects and prefix-confirmed events (Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 现有流线跟踪和推理框架在时间上传播隐含状态:选定实例的目标查询(Wu等人,2023年),基于SAM2的视觉和面具记忆(Cuttano等人,2025年;Ravi等人,2024年),反复出现的语言嵌入或信物库(Zhang等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年b),或重新评价键框背景(Kao等人,2026年). 长视频模型同样保留视觉记忆库或压缩的KV缓存(He等人,2024年;Song等人,2024年;Di等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年a;Xiao等人,2026年;Shen等人,2025年). 然而,这些方法依赖于连续的视觉特征或隐含的潜伏符号,一旦视觉证据退出当地时间窗口,这些符号就难以保存象征性事件的历史. Sekai转而携带一个明确、可编辑的物体和前缀确认事件文字内存(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: Referring and reasoning VOS benchmarks, including ReVOS ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , MeViS v2 ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , and ReasonVOS ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , associate each expression with static instance identities across the video; recent extensions add motion intervals ( Deng et al., 2025 ) or causal referent shifts ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , but allow at most one target at a time, and none annotates the events that establish eligibility. Isekai annotates these events directly and derives time-varying, zero-to-many target sets from them (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 转录和推理VOS基准,包括ReVOS(Yan等人,2024年),MeViS v2(Ding等人,2025年),以及ReasonVOS(Bai等人,2024年),将每个表达方式与整个视频的静态实例身份联系起来;最近的扩展增加了运动间隔(Deng等人,2025年)或因果参考转移(Liu等人,2026年),但最多一次允许一个目标,没有说明确定资格的事件. Isekai直接对这些事件进行注释,并从中得出时间变化多端、零比多的目标(表1)。

blocks.en: 3 Isekai: Diagnostic Benchmark
blocks.zh: Isekai:诊断基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑业

blocks.en: Isekai builds on videos and instance masks from MeViS v2 ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , GroundMoRe ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , and DAVIS 2017 ( Pont-Tuset et al., 2017 ) : 60 videos, 197 fixed queries, and 12,569 scoring points (Table 3.3 ). Isekai is evaluation-only; Sekai is neither trained nor tuned on it (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: Isekai基于MeViS v2(Ding等人,2025年),GroundMore(Deng等人,2025年)和DAVIS 2017(Pont-Tuset等人,2017年)的视频和实例口罩:60个视频,197个固定查询,12,569个评分点(表3.3). Isekai只进行评价;Sekai既没有受过培训,也没有接受过培训(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: Starting from automatically proposed object–event intervals, annotators verify each event’s participants and boundaries and mark the first frame at which the prefix confirms it. An event is marked ended only with observed ending evidence, and events whose order cannot be resolved are excluded from scoring. The target set at a frame is the eligible instances that are also visible in the official masks (Figure 2 ; Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 从自动提出的对象-事件间隔开始,注释者会验证每个事件的参与者和边界,并标记前缀确认的第一个框架. 某一事件仅以观察到的终结证据而告终,其顺序无法解决的事件被排除在积分之外. 框架设定的目标是同样可见于官方口罩中的合格实例(图2;附录A)。

blocks.en: A second annotator, without access to the original labels, re-annotated the events in 20 videos. On the 2,307 resulting Now / Ever / Never scoring points (Section 3.2 ), the two annotations give identical target sets on 93.0% (mean Jaccard 0.940 0.940 ), although 80.6% of individual events match one-to-one (Appendix A.3 ). Target sets are thus more stable than the event segmentations that produce them.
blocks.zh: 第二位无法访问原始标签的注释员,在20个视频中重新对事件进行了说明. 在产生的2,307 Now / Ever / Never 评分(第3.2节)上,两份说明给出了93.0%的相同目标集(平均为Jaccard 0.940 0.940),尽管80.6%的单个事件匹配一对一(附录A.3). 因此,各套目标比产生这些目标的事件划分更为稳定。

Of the 12,569 points, 5,379 have an empty target set and 1,028 have more than one target, so both departures from the single-target setting are common.

blocks.en: 3.2 Query families
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 查询家庭

blocks.en: Isekai has eleven query families (Table 6 ). The five primary families apply one predicate each to the event history: Now selects the current participants, Ever all participants so far, Never their complement, and Latest and First the most recent and the earliest one.
blocks.zh: Isekai有11个查询家庭(表6)。 五个初级家庭对事件历史各适用一个前提: 现在挑选目前的参与者,到目前为止所有参与者,永远不要补充,最新和最早期的参与者。

blocks.en: The six compound families add counting, ordering, role chains, and duration; “Who was the first player to take a shot after dribbling the ball themselves?” must bind the shooter to an earlier dribbling event by the same instance. Appendix A.1 gives the formal predicates and boundary cases. Results pool the 38 queries outside Now , Ever , Latest , and Never as Other .

blocks.en: 3.3 Diagnostic protocol and metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 诊断规程和衡量标准

blocks.en: Evidence age is the number of frames from the supporting event’s confirmation to the scoring frame, in four strata: in window (confirmed within the current chunk), 1–8, 9–24, and 25+. A scoring point is in the history subset if its target set changes when recomputed from only the events confirmed in the current chunk, i.e., its answer depends on evidence outside the window. The subset is defined on Now , Ever , and Never , whose targets follow from the event rules, and contains 4,133 of its 8,980 points.

blocks.en: Sekai obtains the best overall J&F and the best score on Ever (Table 3 ). The remaining family columns are split among the baselines, and Table 11 shows why: CoT-RVS is strong on empty points but collapses on single-target points, StreamingRVOS the reverse, so each leads the families whose empty-frame proportion (Figure 3 ) matches its bias toward withholding or emitting a mask. Sekai is the only method without a collapsed regime across empty, single-, and multi-target points, which is what the overall score rewards.
blocks.zh: Sekai获得最佳整体J&F和Ever最佳得分(表3). 其余的家族柱被划分为基线,表11显示了为什么: CoT-RVS在空点上很强,但在单目标点上倒塌,StreamingRVOS反向,因此每个家族都领导着其空框比例(图3)与其偏向于扣下或排放面具的家族. 塞凯是唯一一个没有崩溃的制度跨越空的,单的,和多目标分数的方法,这是总分的奖励.

blocks.en: The gain is concentrated on Ever , where Sekai leads the strongest baseline by 9.28 and the memory-free control by 4.58: an Ever target stays eligible after its event ends and its evidence leaves the window, which is exactly the state the EMR carries. The control also trails on Now and the compound families but is higher on Latest and Never , where the same memory becomes a liability: a stale or spurious entry is never revisited, so on Latest an older participant is not superseded and on Never one wrong entry excludes an instance for the rest of the video (deltas in Appendix D.3 ). On the history subset Sekai is above the control and within 3 points of StreamingRVOS. With ground-truth boxes the same segmentor reaches 87.80 (Table 5 ), so the remaining error lies mostly in target selection, not mask decoding.

blocks.en: Figure 5 scores every method on the same nonempty points per stratum (values in Table 10 ). Every baseline declines with evidence age; the memory-free control holds through 24 frames and drops 7.7 points at 25+, while Sekai is the only method whose curve is flat. The crossovers have a mechanical reading: for two or three chunks the qualifying instance is usually still the salient actor in X k X_{k} , so an appearance prior recovers it without any record of the event; beyond that, only the record identifies who acted. Two caveats bound this. The strata exclude empty frames and so reward emitting a mask: StreamingRVOS, which almost never withholds one, leads every stratum, and even the GT-box oracle scores 41.43 in window because a target confirmed mid-chunk is not prompted until the next endpoint, so the in-window stratum measures anticipation as much as reasoning. Conversely, Table 11 shows the memory is neutral on nonempty points and gains 11.11 on empty ones; the strata therefore show only half of its contribution, retaining old-evidence targets, and cannot register the other half, withholding a mask when nothing visible qualifies.

blocks.zh: 5.4 定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows two correct selections and one failure from the run in Table 3 , all Count queries (“at least two separate occasions”), the family that exercises both modules: the writer must keep the occurrences as separate closed entries, and the locator must count entries rather than read the chunk, since an eight-frame chunk typically shows at most one occurrence and reveals that it is the second. In the first two rows the MGD selects the runner and the breakdancer at frame 56; a chunk-only reader can make these selections only by guessing the salient actor, the behavior the 9–24 stratum rewards and the 25+ stratum exposes.
blocks.zh: 图6显示表3中两个正确的选择和一个运行失败,所有伯爵查询(“至少两个单独的次”),两个模块都进行练习的家族:写手必须把发生作为单独的封闭条目,定位符必须计数条目,而不是读取块,因为一个八帧块通常最多显示一个发生,并显示它是第二个发生. 在前两行,MGD选择了56帧的跑者与断层器;只有块块的读者才能通过猜测突出的演员,9–24层的奖励行为和25+层的曝光来做出这些选择.

blocks.en: In the third row, Sekai selects the dancer at frame 64, although the label turns positive only at frame 79; the error is one of timing, not identity. Both modules err. The EMR stores the arm-raising as a single Active entry with evidence frames 0 and 64: because an entry closes only on observed ending evidence, a missed ending lets the writer extend one entry rather than open a second, merging the “separate occasions” the query asks about. Count on this memory gives one, so a faithful readout would have withheld a box; that the MGD emitted one indicates it fell back to the chunk, where the raised arms are visible. Since the locator does not emit the IDs it selects, the two errors cannot be separated in the output; the case instantiates the pattern behind the Latest and Never deficits in Table 3 , a record wrong once and never revisited, and motivates both the ID readout and the re-verification step of Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 第三行中,Sekai在帧64中选择舞者,尽管标签只在帧79中变为正;错误是时间,而不是身份. 两个模块都错了。 EMR将举臂存储为单一的主动输入,有证据框架0和64:由于一个条目只关闭在可观察到的终结证据上,一个缺失的结束让编剧延长一个条目而不是打开第二个条目,合并了询问所询问的“单独场合”。 凭着这个记忆,一个忠实的读出会扣下一个盒子;磁共振显示它掉回了竖起的手臂可见的块。 由于定位器没有发出它所选择的ID,所以两个错误无法在输出中分离;该案例即时地描述表3中最新和永不缺失背后的图案,一个记录错误一次,再也没有重审,并激励了ID读出和第6节的重新验证步骤.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Sekai’s carried state is a text memory written by a frozen model, and the design accepts a trade-off: what the writer records stays available indefinitely, but what it misrecords is not revisited, since later calls cannot re-examine frames that have left the window. Knowledge accumulated in increments also accumulates its errors. Table 3 shows both sides: the same memory that carries Ever targets past their evidence can also hold a stale entry that hurts Latest and Never , so a verification step that re-checks entries against new evidence is the natural next component. The locator, adapted partly on synthetic memories, selects from the memory without emitting the IDs it selects; an explicit ID readout would make cases such as the third row of Figure 6 diagnosable at the module level.
blocks.zh: Sekai的承载状态是一个被冷冻的模型所写的文本内存,设计接受一种权衡:编剧记录无限期保留,但其错误记录却不被重审,因为后来的呼叫无法重新审查离开窗口的帧. 积累在递增中的知识也会累积其错误. 表3显示的是两侧: 相同的内存 目标一旦越过证据, 就会发现一个有刺眼的入口, 部分根据合成记忆改编的定位器从内存中选择,而不泄露它所选择的ID;一个明确的ID读出会使得像图6第三行在模块层面可以诊断的案例.

blocks.en: GRVS treats the streaming target set as a function of the observed event history that may be empty, single, or plural at any frame. Isekai measures this frame by frame with event-derived targets and evidence-age strata. Sekai shows that a bounded text record of who did what, and when, retains targets after their evidence leaves the window, with its clearest margin over prior methods on EVER queries and, relative to a memory-free control, on the oldest evidence. Keeping that record correct, and reading it for recency and negation, remain open.
blocks.zh: GRVS将流线目标集作为观测到的事件历史的一个函数,它可能在任何框架上都是空的,单的,或者复数的. Isekai以事件衍生目标和证据年龄等级为框架衡量这一框架。 Sekai显示,在证据离开窗口后,有关于谁做了哪些事,何时保留了目标,相对于EVER查询的先前方法,以及相对于无记忆控制而言,最古老的证据,它具有最明确的差值。 保持这一记录的正确性,并读取其正确性和否定性,仍然是公开的。

blocks.en: Machine proposals provide candidate object–condition intervals. blocks.en: B.1 Schedule and Module Interface
blocks.zh: B.1 时间表和模块接口

blocks.en: The EMR’s writer and the MGD’s locator use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) ; SAM 3.1 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) is frozen. Calls follow the first-frame schedule in Section 4 : initialize on x 0 x_{0} , then process X k = x a k : b k X_{k}=x_{a_{k}:b_{k}} with a 1 = b 1 = 0 a_{1}=b_{1}=0 and a k = b k − 1 + 1 a_{k}=b_{k-1}+1 . A final partial chunk is processed if the video ends off-schedule. The writer reads q q , X k X_{k} , and M k − 1 M_{k-1} and replaces the EMR memory. The locator reads q q , X k X_{k} , and the new memory in a fresh context. Both the EMR memory and locator rendering are validated against the 128-token budget. Event indices record first and most recent evidence, not guaranteed event boundaries.
B.2 Event Memory Reasoner
blocks.zh: B.2 事件记忆因子

blocks.en: The active writer instruction requires stable local IDs, observed appearance and locations, event labels, event states, evidence indices, complete replacement output, and a 128-token limit. It forbids inventing events or treating disappearance as an ending.
blocks.zh: 活动写作指令需要稳定的本地ID,可观察到的外观和位置,事件标签,事件状态,证据指数,完整的替换输出,以及128个托肯限制. 它禁止制造事件或将失踪视为结局。

blocks.en: An over-budget output is rejected and regenerated, with at most three identical attempts. Both the memory and its locator rendering must fit within 128 tokens. In the 1,770 writer-call logs, 11 calls (0.7%) encountered the budget limit. After repeated failure, the previous accepted memory and segmentation state are carried forward; the failure remains in the evaluation denominator.
blocks.zh: 超预算产出被拒绝并重新生成,最多三次相同的尝试。 记忆器及其定位器渲染必须符合128个符号. 在1,770个写作记录中,11个电话(0.7%)遇到预算限制。 重复失败后,将之前接受的内存和分解状态结转;失败仍留在评价分母中.

blocks.en: B.3 Memory-Grounded Decoder
blocks.zh: B.3 内存圆形编解码器

blocks.en: Grammar-constrained decoding validates the single top-level JSON response. The locator always returns a list of boxes, including an empty list. Coordinates use normalized [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] xyxy values, and malformed, truncated, or degenerate boxes are invalid.
blocks.zh: 语法约束解码验证单顶级JSON响应. 定位器总是返回一个框列表,包括一个空列表. 坐标使用正态 [0, 1000] [0, 1000] xyxy值, 且不正确, 截断, 或变质的框无效 。

blocks.en: The active reference run freezes the writer, vision backbone, token embeddings, and segmentor, and adapts the locator with response-only cross-entropy. It uses 3,579 real samples and 2,592 synthetic samples from the released MeViS v2 training corpus. Real samples pair queries and current chunks with writer-generated memory states and annotated endpoint boxes; synthetic samples pair object descriptions and endpoint geometry with hypothetical temporal states. The main locator uses LoRA rank 16, scaling 32, dropout 0.05, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , and effective batch size 4 (two real and two synthetic samples).
blocks.zh: 活跃的参考运行冻结了编剧,视觉主干,符号嵌入,和分区器,并调整了定位器,只使用响应的交叉切变. 它使用了3,579个真实样品和2,592个合成样品,这些样品来自释放的MeViS v2训练册. 真实的样本配对查询和当前块,带有作者生成的内存状态和注释端点框;合成样本配对对象描述和带有假设时间状态的端点几何. 主定位器采用LORA排名16,缩放32,辍学率0.05,学习率2×10−5 2\times 10×5},有效批量尺寸4(两个真样和两个合成样).

blocks.en: The active locator instruction asks for every visible instance satisfying the original query in the last frame and permits an empty box list. Full prompt text, validators, and exact serialization are included in the public repository.
blocks.zh: 正在运行的定位指令要求每个可见实例满足最后一个框架中的原始查询,并允许一个空框列表. 完整的即时文本,验证器,以及准确的序列化都包含在公共寄存器中.

blocks.en: We manually checked the complete source-video manifests for Isekai and locator training, and reviewed all candidate overlaps identified by the available-frame duplicate checks. To the best of our knowledge, none of the 60 Isekai videos overlaps with the source videos used for locator training, including the sources of real samples and the video geometry used in synthetic samples. This check concerns locator-training data; it does not establish separation from foundation-model pretraining data.
blocks.zh: 我们手动检查了Isekai和定位器培训的全部源视频清单,并审查了现有框架重复检查确定的所有候选人重叠情况。 据我们所知,60个Isekai视频中没有一个与定位器培训所用的原始视频重叠,包括真实样本的来源和合成样本中使用的视频几何。 这一检查涉及定位-培训数据;它没有确定与基础模型预培训数据分离。

blocks.en: B.4 Inference Procedure
blocks.zh: B.4 推论程序

blocks.en: 1. Initialize empty semantic memory and segmentation state. 2. At each reasoning endpoint, run the EMR (writer) on the arrived chunk, the query, and the previous memory; validate the replacement memory. 3. In a fresh context, run the MGD’s locator on the new memory and the same chunk; validate its endpoint boxes. 4. Use the MGD’s segmentor to apply valid boxes to the endpoint frame. A valid empty list clears active segmentation state while preserving semantic memory. 5. Use the MGD’s segmentor to propagate accepted masks on intervening arrived frames and carry the memory to the next endpoint.
blocks.zh: 1. 初始化空语义记忆和分解状态. 2. 在每个推理端点上,运行到达块上的EMR(写作机),查询,以及以前的内存;验证替换内存. 3. 在新的背景下,在新的内存和同一块上运行磁共振定位器;验证其端点框。 4. 使用MGD的分机对端点框架应用有效的框. 一个有效的空列表在保存语义记忆的同时清除活动分区状态. 5. 使用MGD的分机在中间到达的帧上传播已接受的口罩,并将内存带到下一个终点。

blocks.en: OnlineRefer ( Wu et al., 2023 ) receives the fixed query and newly arrived frames while retaining its target representation. The online branch follows a single object of interest and can switch targets. OnlineRefer uses the official Swin-L checkpoint trained on Refer-YouTube-VOS; our CoT-RVS adaptation uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and SAM 3.1.
